blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Saturday, Sept. 19, claimed that those going up against Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson may end up being targeted by him. The senator is referring to the investigations led by Lacson on the alleged ghost infrastructure and reclamation projects in Taguig City, which is Cayetano’s political bailiwick. “Meron ngang iba [government infrastructure projects], napatunayan na may ghost, pero tahimik, walang imbestigasyon. So ano po ang sagot nila? Sagot nila, hindi dapat Taguig, hindi dapat kay Alan, hindi dapat yung mga Cayetano managot,” he said in a Facebook livestream. (“There are indeed other […]...
